scores.label: A
scores.note: 2-4 are wordy and redundant (proportion plus range); 4 'resulted in the mortality of' is awkward

scores.label: B
scores.note: 1: 'mortality rates fluctuated' changes the meaning; 2 and 5: 'thirty to fifty percent' changes the number (a third is not thirty percent); 4: 'mortality rates spanned ... of the continent's residents' is ill-formed and loses the plague as cause

scores.label: C
scores.note: 1: 'eradicated' is the wrong word for killing a fraction of people; 2: 'nearly one-third' shifts the lower bound below a third
